summary: Retain runtime direct-eval semantics for String source in a non-strict caller.

semantics.declarations: can interact with caller var environment under sloppy rules

tests.name: reads local
tests.input: function f(){let x=3; return eval('x')} console.log(f());

tests.name: var can affect sloppy function
tests.input: function f(){eval('var x=4'); return x} console.log(f());

caveats: Do not approximate with C# expression evaluation or compilation in a fresh scope.
